name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Threat Detection Collar TDC-2
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Threat Detection Collar TDC-2
description: A collar-worn sensor array that provides 360-degree threat detection by monitoring acoustic signatures, electromagnetic emissions, laser designators, and chemical agent presence in the wearer's environment. The TDC-2 interfaces with the wearer's neural implant to deliver threat warnings as intuitive spatial awareness — the wearer feels the direction and distance of detected threats as if they had a sixth sense, rather than processing visual alerts. The system can detect an aimed weapon by its electromagnetic signature, incoming projectiles by their acoustic wavefront, and laser designators by reflected scatter. The result is a constant awareness of danger that becomes as natural as hearing.
story_hooks: A TDC-2 wearer detected a threat signature from an empty room — the collar identified electromagnetic patterns consistent with an aimed weapon, but no weapon or operator was found. The signature appeared again 24 hours later.
TDC-2 data logs have been subpoenaed as evidence in a self-defense case — the collar's recordings show exactly when the wearer perceived the threat and whether the response was proportionate.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A rigid, modular collar assembly that sits flush against the base of the neck and upper shoulders. The design resembles a segmented tactical piece rather than jewelry — industrial and purposeful. The front features a central control node flanked by sensor pods that curve around the sides.
physical_description.weight_description: Handheld weight (150g) — barely noticeable when worn; distributes evenly across shoulders
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite with embedded sensor arrays; aluminum alloy mounting brackets
physical_description.finish: Matte tactical black with brushed metallic accents; surface texture is slightly ribbed for grip and sensor optimization
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black primary with gunmetal gray sensor pods; amber and red LED indicator clusters along the front collar face
physical_description.interface_elements: Dual tactile pressure-response buttons (top center); small holographic micro-display embedded in the front node (displays battery/status in low-light); three micro-ports (neural interface jack on right side, charging port on left, diagnostics port rear-center); wireless proximity indicator LEDs
distinctive_features: Segmented sensor pods that protrude slightly from the collar curve, giving it a crested appearance
Pulsing amber LEDs that intensify to red when threats are detected
Micro-holographic status display that projects minimalist threat vector data
Articulated rear fastening system with quick-release magnetic clasp
Acoustic detection membranes visible as subtle ribbed surfaces on the upper curve
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Aegis Vehicle Works logo (stylized shield) embossed on center front node; TDC-2 designation laser-etched beneath logo; regulatory compliance stamps on rear clasp
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn snugly against the neck with neural interface cable routed beneath collar; indicator LEDs active (soft amber in idle state); faint electronic humming audible in quiet environments
